mapper.sql: and copywriting_id in ( select copywriting.copywriting_id from t_copywriting copywriting inner join t_copywriting_expert_assignment expert_assignment on expert_assignment.account_user_id = copywriting.user_id inner join t_user expert_user on expert_user.user_id = expert_assignment.expert_user_id where expert_assignment.expert_user_id = #{currentProcessorId} and coalesce(expert_user.status, 0) = 0 and exists ( select 1 from t_user_role_map expert_role_map inner join t_role expert_role on expert_role.role_id = expert_role_map.role_id where expert_role_map.user_id = expert_assignment.expert_user_id and upper(expert_role.name) = 'EXPERT' ) )

and copywriting_id in ( select copywriting.copywriting_id from t_copywriting copywriting inner join t_copywriting_organization_admin_assignment admin_assignment on admin_assignment.account_user_id = copywriting.user_id inner join t_user admin_user on admin_user.user_id = admin_assignment.admin_user_id where admin_assignment.admin_user_id = #{currentProcessorId} and coalesce(admin_user.status, 0) = 0 and exists ( select 1 from t_user_role_map admin_role_map inner join t_role admin_role on admin_role.role_id = admin_role_map.role_id where admin_role_map.user_id = admin_assignment.admin_user_id and upper(admin_role.name) = 'ORG_ADMIN' ) )

exists ( select 1 from t_user scope_admin inner join t_user_role_map scope_admin_role_map on scope_admin_role_map.user_id = scope_admin.user_id inner join t_role scope_admin_role on scope_admin_role.role_id = scope_admin_role_map.role_id where scope_admin.user_id = #{actorUserId} and coalesce(scope_admin.status, 0) = 0 and upper(scope_admin_role.name) in ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN') )

and exists ( select 1 from t_user workflow_admin inner join t_user_role_map workflow_admin_role_map on workflow_admin_role_map.user_id = workflow_admin.user_id inner join t_role workflow_admin_role on workflow_admin_role.role_id = workflow_admin_role_map.role_id where workflow_admin.user_id = #{scopeActorId} and coalesce(workflow_admin.status, 0) = 0 and upper(workflow_admin_role.name) in ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN') )

choose.when: and (approval_flow.current_processor_id is null or approval_flow.current_processor_id = #{actorUserId}) and exists ( select 1 from t_copywriting copywriting inner join t_copywriting_expert_assignment assignment on assignment.account_user_id = copywriting.user_id inner join t_user reviewer on reviewer.user_id = assignment.expert_user_id and coalesce(reviewer.status, 0) = 0 where copywriting.copywriting_id = approval_flow.copywriting_id and assignment.expert_user_id = #{actorUserId} and exists ( select 1 from t_user_role_map role_map inner join t_role role on role.role_id = role_map.role_id where role_map.user_id = #{actorUserId} and upper(role.name) = 'EXPERT' ) )

and (approval_flow.current_processor_id is null or approval_flow.current_processor_id = #{actorUserId}) and exists ( select 1 from t_copywriting copywriting inner join t_copywriting_organization_admin_assignment assignment on assignment.account_user_id = copywriting.user_id inner join t_user reviewer on reviewer.user_id = assignment.admin_user_id and coalesce(reviewer.status, 0) = 0 where copywriting.copywriting_id = approval_flow.copywriting_id and assignment.admin_user_id = #{actorUserId} and exists ( select 1 from t_user_role_map role_map inner join t_role role on role.role_id = role_map.role_id where role_map.user_id = #{actorUserId} and upper(role.name) = 'ORG_ADMIN' ) )

mapper.update: update t_copywriting_approval_flow set current_status = 1, update_time = now(), current_processor_id=null where copywriting_approval_flow_id = #{copywritingApprovalFlowId} and copywriting_id = #{copywritingId} and current_status = 2 and current_processor_id is null and #{scopeActorId} = 0

update t_copywriting_approval_flow set current_processor_id = #{currentProcessorId}, update_time = now() where copywriting_approval_flow_id = #{copywritingApprovalFlowId} and current_processor_id IS NULL and current_status = 1
and exists ( select 1 from t_user_role_map urm inner join t_role r on r.role_id = urm.role_id where urm.user_id = #{currentProcessorId} and upper(r.name) = 'EXPERT' )

update t_copywriting_approval_flow set current_processor_id = #{currentProcessorId}, update_time = now() where copywriting_approval_flow_id = #{copywritingApprovalFlowId} and current_processor_id IS NULL and current_status = 3

select id, copywriting_approval_flow_id, copywriting_id, current_processor_id, current_status, create_time, update_time from t_copywriting_approval_flow where copywriting_id = #{copywritingId} order by id desc limit 1

select approval_flow.id, approval_flow.copywriting_approval_flow_id, approval_flow.copywriting_id, approval_flow.current_processor_id, approval_flow.current_status, approval_flow.create_time, approval_flow.update_time from t_copywriting_approval_flow approval_flow where approval_flow.current_status = #{approvalStatus}
order by approval_flow.copywriting_approval_flow_id desc limit #{offset}, #{size}
